stable.notes: The live activity line is readable. It shared the title column with the age and workspace stack, which left it about 84 points — under twenty characters, not enough to show one whole word of a scrolling sentence. It now has its own full-width line beneath the title at 209 points with a slightly larger face: 39 characters visible instead of 18. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
